name: iOS195 4.59 private signed artifact only
run-name: iOS signed artifact 4.59 (195) from 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/ios195-459-signing-envelope-20261109]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

# Shared with the upload path; manual/out-of-band Apple actions still need coordination.
concurrency:
  group: ios-testflight-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build-export-verify-private:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'yarinn12/sogrim-hashbon' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/ios195-459-signing-envelope-20261109' && github.workflow_ref == 'yarinn12/sogrim-hashbon/.github/workflows/ios195-459-private-sign-only-envelope-20261109.yml@refs/heads/codex/ios195-459-signing-envelope-20261109' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.run_attempt == 1 && github.event.created == true && github.event.before == '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' && github.event.forced == false && github.event.deleted == false }}
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 75
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: app
    env:
      SOURCE_SHA: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
      SOURCE_TREE: "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222"
      SOURCE_QA_RUN: "710001"
      SOURCE_WINDOWS_QA_RUN: "710002"
      SOURCE_FONT_QA_RUN: "710003"
      SOURCE_AUTH_QA_RUN: "710004"
      WORKFLOW_COMMIT: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
      WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
      APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ vars.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
      APPSTORE_ISSUER_ID: ${{ vars.APPSTORE_ISSUER_ID }}
      APPSTORE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ vars.APPSTORE_API_KEY_ID }}
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
      GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID }}
      IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE: "Sogrim Hashbon App Store 2026"
      IOS_VERSION: "4.59"
      IOS_BUILD: "195"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable first-creation controls only
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: release-bootstrap
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Select Node24 for first-creation controls
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Require first branch creation and two complete workflow histories
        id: first_creation
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-bootstrap/scripts/qa/ios-signing/first-creation-guard.mjs" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ios195-first-creation-envelope-20261109"

      - name: Validate mandatory frozen source and release inputs
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          node -e 'const a=require("node:assert/strict");a.match(process.env.SOURCE_SHA??"",/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);a.equal(process.env.SOURCE_SHA,"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111");a.equal(process.env.IOS_VERSION,"4.59");a.equal(process.env.IOS_BUILD,"195");for(const k of ["SOURCE_QA_RUN","SOURCE_WINDOWS_QA_RUN","SOURCE_FONT_QA_RUN","SOURCE_AUTH_QA_RUN"])a.match(process.env[k]??"",/^[1-9][0-9]*$/);'

      - name: Checkout the frozen application source explicitly
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
          path: app
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout the immutable workflow and shared release helpers
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: release-tools
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: app/package-lock.json

      - name: Load public release notes from the frozen application metadata
        run: node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/load-release-notes.mjs"
      - name: Check source CI, duplicate slots, application identity, encryption and web-asset rejection controls
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing
        run: |
          node --test preparation.test.mjs ../../../tests/iosReleaseAppleRead.test.mjs ../../../tests/iosFirstCreationGuard.test.mjs
          python3 test_web_assets.py
      - name: Check signing certificate command and rejection controls before Apple keys
        run: python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/test-signing-certificate.py"

      - name: Require all four successful source CI runs before signing secrets
        env:
          IOS_FIRST_CREATION_RECEIPT: ${{ steps.first_creation.outputs.receipt_path }}
          IOS_FIRST_CREATION_SHA256: ${{ steps.first_creation.outputs.receipt_sha256 }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/source-guard.mjs" ci-only

      - name: Require pinned source CI and read unused build number before signing
        env:
          IOS_FIRST_CREATION_RECEIPT: ${{ steps.first_creation.outputs.receipt_path }}
          IOS_FIRST_CREATION_SHA256: ${{ steps.first_creation.outputs.receipt_sha256 }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/source-guard.mjs" before-build

      - name: Validate existing Apple configuration
        run: node scripts/verify-ios-workflow-env.mjs
        env:
          APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          APPSTORE_CERTIFICATES_FILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_CERTIFICATES_FILE_BASE64 }}
          APPSTORE_CERTIFICATES_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_CERTIFICATES_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Verify public Apple login provider readiness by reading existing configuration
        run: npm run qa:ios:providers

      - name: Select and verify Xcode 26.6 and iPhone SDK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_26.6.app
          xcodebuild -version
          xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-version

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build web assets and prepare the native project from the pinned checkout
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm run native:ios:flatten-icon
          npm run native:prepare
          node scripts/prepare-ios-release.mjs
          npm run qa:ios
          python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/verify-web-assets.py" snapshot

      - name: Import the existing Apple Distribution certificate
        uses: apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v7
        with:
          p12-file-base64: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_CERTIFICATES_FILE_BASE64 }}
          p12-password: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_CERTIFICATES_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Download an existing active App Store provisioning profile
        uses: apple-actions/download-provisioning-profiles@v6
        with:
          bundle-id: com.sogrimhashbon.app
          profile-type: IOS_APP_STORE
          issuer-id: ${{ vars.APPSTORE_ISSUER_ID }}
          api-key-id: ${{ vars.APPSTORE_API_KEY_ID }}
          api-private-key: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Resolve Swift packages and retain the resolved dependency identity
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App
          resolved="ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved"
          test -f "$resolved"
          cp "$resolved" build/ios/Package.resolved

      - name: Archive signed iOS app without sending anything to Apple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          xcodebuild \
            -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj \
            -scheme App \
            -configuration Release \
            -destination "generic/platform=iOS" \
            -archivePath build/ios/SogrimHashbon.xcarchive \
            clean archive \
            DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$APPLE_TEAM_ID" \
            | tee build/ios/archive.log

      - name: Export IPA locally without upload destination
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :destination' ios/ExportOptions.generated.plist | grep -x export
          xcodebuild \
            -exportArchive \
            -archivePath build/ios/SogrimHashbon.xcarchive \
            -exportOptionsPlist ios/ExportOptions.generated.plist \
            -exportPath build/ios/export \
            | tee build/ios/export.log
          python3 - <<'EXPORT'
          from pathlib import Path
          import shutil
          files = list(Path('build/ios/export').rglob('*.ipa'))
          if len(files) != 1:
              raise ValueError('Expected exactly one exported IPA')
          shutil.copyfile(files[0], 'build/ios/SogrimHashbon.ipa')
          EXPORT

      - name: Verify signed iOS artifact with the existing signature verifier
        run: npm run qa:ios:artifact

      - name: Recheck exact source CI and current unused number after export
        env:
          IOS_FIRST_CREATION_RECEIPT: ${{ steps.first_creation.outputs.receipt_path }}
          IOS_FIRST_CREATION_SHA256: ${{ steps.first_creation.outputs.receipt_sha256 }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/source-guard.mjs" after-export

      - name: Require all packaged web assets, release entitlements and valid distribution profile
        run: python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/verify-web-assets.py" verify

      - name: Encrypt only the verified IPA and its evidence for private retention
        env:
          APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tar -cf "$RUNNER_TEMP/sogrim-ios-release.tar" -C build/ios \
            SogrimHashbon.ipa release-manifest.json artifact-verification.json \
            source-ci-only.json source-before-build.json source-after-export.json web-assets.json Package.resolved
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/protect-artifact.mjs" encrypt \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/sogrim-ios-release.tar" build/ios/private-artifact

      - name: Retain only encrypted release output for seven days
        id: private_artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: sogrim-ios-4.59-195-encrypted
          path: |
            app/build/ios/private-artifact/release.tar.enc
            app/build/ios/private-artifact/envelope.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Record preparation outcome
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' \
            'Signed iOS 4.59 (195) artifact prepared from 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111.' \
            'The retained artifact is encrypted and requires the existing App Store API private key to decrypt.' \
            'No TestFlight upload, App Review submission, device acceptance or build-number reservation was performed.' \
            >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, plistlib, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile, zipfile

SOURCE='abcbac91e97230e4737e80c4ea3c2206360e855f'
TREE='76e2319de17a875db5f5b1e2b54c2b63659644b1'
FILES={'SogrimHashbon.ipa','release-manifest.json','artifact-verification.json','source-ci-only.json','source-before-build.json','source-after-export.json','web-assets.json','Package.resolved'}

def require(value,message):
    if not value: raise ValueError(message)

def unpack(archive,destination):
    destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with tarfile.open(archive,'r:') as tar:
        members=tar.getmembers()
        require(len(members)==8 and {m.name for m in members}==FILES,'Unexpected release archive entries')
        require(all(m.isfile() and not m.issym() and not m.islnk() for m in members),'Non-regular release archive entry')
        for m in members:
            target=destination/m.name
            require(not target.exists(),'Refuse to replace an existing release evidence file')
        for m in members:
            with (destination/m.name).open('xb') as out:
                with tar.extractfile(m) as data: out.write(data.read())

def verify_identity(root,envelope,origin):
    directory=root/'build/ios'
    identity=json.loads(envelope['aad'])
    require(identity['sourceCommit']==SOURCE and identity['sourceTree']==TREE,'Wrong authenticated source')
    require(identity['version']=='4.59' and identity['build']=='195','Wrong authenticated release')
    require(str(identity['buildRunId'])==origin['signingRunId'] and str(identity['buildRunAttempt'])=='1','Wrong authenticated signing run')
    sha=hashlib.sha256((directory/'SogrimHashbon.ipa').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    require(sha==identity['ipaSha256']==origin['ipaSha256'],'Original IPA bytes changed')
    proof=json.loads((directory/'artifact-verification.json').read_text())
    manifest=json.loads((directory/'release-manifest.json').read_text())
    for r in (proof,manifest):
        require(r['sourceCommit']==SOURCE and r['sourceTree']==TREE and r['version']=='4.59' and r['build']=='195','Release evidence mismatch')
        require(r['ipaSha256']==sha and r['signatureVerified'] is True and r['everyWwwAssetMatches'] is True,'Original verification missing')
        require(r.get('everyWwwAssetMatchesCanonicalGitBuild') is True,'Original canonical Git verification missing')
        require(r['appleUploadPerformed'] is False,'Artifact was already marked as uploaded')
    require(manifest['sha256'].lower()==sha,'Manifest IPA hash mismatch')
    expected=json.loads((directory/'web-assets.json').read_text())
    canonical=expected.get('canonicalGit',{})
    require(canonical.get('sourceCommit')==SOURCE and canonical.get('sourceTree')==TREE,
            'Canonical asset proof belongs to another source')
    require(canonical.get('independentCanonicalBuild') is True and
            canonical.get('allArchiveBytesMatchGitBlobs') is True and
            canonical.get('gitInputCount',0)>500,'Original canonical Git byte proof missing')
    require(canonical.get('www')==expected.get('www'),'Original WWW map differs from canonical Git build')
    live=json.loads((directory/'live-ci-before-download.json').read_text())
    require(live['sourceCommit']==SOURCE and live['sourceTree']==TREE,'Live source fingerprint belongs to another source')
    for name in ('source-ci-only','source-before-build','source-after-export'):
        receipt=json.loads((directory/(name+'.json')).read_text())
        require(receipt['sourceCommit']==SOURCE and receipt['sourceTree']==TREE,'Source receipt mismatch')
        require(str(receipt['buildRunId'])==origin['signingRunId'] and str(receipt['buildRunAttempt'])=='1','Source receipt signing run mismatch')
        require(receipt['workflowCommit']==origin['signingTools'],'Wrong original signing tools')
        require(receipt['sourceInputs']==live['sourceInputs'],'Original source inputs differ from current pinned Git checkout')
        require(receipt['packageSha256']==live['packageSha256'] and
                receipt['packageLockSha256']==live['packageLockSha256'],'Original package inputs differ from current pinned Git checkout')
    return sha

def main():
    root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); directory=root/'build/ios'
    envelope=json.loads((directory/'original-encrypted/envelope.json').read_text())
    origin=json.loads((directory/'upload-origin.json').read_text())
    unpack(pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'sogrim-original-release.tar',directory)
    sha=verify_identity(root,envelope,origin)
    expected=json.loads((directory/'web-assets.json').read_text())
    require(expected['sourceCommit']==SOURCE and expected['sourceTree']==TREE,'Wrong original asset snapshot')
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_web_guard',pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])/'release-tools/scripts/qa/ios-signing/verify-web-assets.py')
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(directory/'SogrimHashbon.ipa') as ipa: app=module.inspect_zip(ipa,expected)
    require(sys.platform=='darwin','Original codesign revalidation requires macOS')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sogrim-original-upload-') as temp:
        subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ditto','-x','-k',str(directory/'SogrimHashbon.ipa'),temp],check=True,capture_output=True)
        path=pathlib.Path(temp)/app
        subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/codesign','--verify','--deep','--strict',str(path)],check=True,capture_output=True)
        module.verify_signing_certificate(path, temp)
        signed=plistlib.loads(subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/codesign','-d','--entitlements',':-',str(path)],check=True,capture_output=True).stdout)
        profile=plistlib.loads(subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/security','cms','-D','-i',str(path/'embedded.mobileprovision')],check=True,capture_output=True).stdout)
        profile_proof=module.validate_profile(profile,signed)
    receipt={'sourceCommit':SOURCE,'sourceTree':TREE,'ipaSha256':sha,'originalSigningRunId':origin['signingRunId'],'rebuilt':False,'signatureReverified':True,'profile':profile_proof,'everyOriginalWebAssetMatches':True,'everyOriginalWebAssetMatchesCanonicalGitBuild':True,'originalSourceInputsMatchCurrentGit':True,'appleUploadPerformed':False}
    (directory/'original-artifact-before-upload.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Authenticated original IPA, complete original asset snapshot, signature and current profile verified; no rebuilding.')

if __name__=='__main__': main()
